headline: KGI's Yang Wen-chun: Dividend policy won't lag; M&A evaluation focuses on banks | Industry
summary: KGI general manager Yang Wen-chun said the holding company's subsidiaries grew strongly in the first half. Life insurance surplus remitted to the holding company was about 10% last year, with a higher ratio expected this year.
why: KGI Financial is a Taiwan-listed financial holding company with securities, banking and insurance units, so its dividend and M&A decisions affect its shareholders and peers.
